Just recently we have heard of the death of Bill Weller. He was a key man in our road running teams in the ’70s - one of Gordon Biscoe’s lads whose teams featured highly in National Road Relays.

Bill Weller was a great clubman – quiet and unassuming with a professional no-nonsense approach. From a team manager’s point of view his reliability was refreshing and his attitude rubbed off onto the younger lads in his teams, for whom he always had words of advice and encouragement.
